Improvement of the disease inflammations , rheumatoid , rheumatic fever , trauma , tumors Ill, Why ESR is increased in these conditions 7 ESR is a sensitive indicator of tissue damage. In these conditions , there is an increase in the level of fibrinogen which causes RBCs to aggregate. Aggregated RBCs have greater density than plasma so they sediment (settle) faster with the effect of gravity. Clinical importance/significance of ESR Advantage: easy and cheap but non-specific i.e. raised ESR does not indicate a particular disease but its decrease indicates improvement of the condition.
